english: Let $\omega=\dfrac{-1+i\sqrt{3}}{2}$, where $i=\sqrt{-1}$, and let $a,b,c$ be real numbers such that $a+b+c=\dfrac{1}{2}$ and $|a+b\omega+c\omega^{2}|=\sqrt{7}$. Then the value of the determinant $\begin{vmatrix}a&b&c\\c&a&b\\b&c&a\end{vmatrix}$ is ______.
hindi: माना कि $\omega=\dfrac{-1+i\sqrt{3}}{2}$ है, जहाँ $i=\sqrt{-1}$ है, तथा $a,b,c$ ऐसी वास्तविक संख्याएँ हैं कि $a+b+c=\dfrac{1}{2}$ तथा $|a+b\omega+c\omega^{2}|=\sqrt{7}$ है। तब सारणिक $\begin{vmatrix}a&b&c\\c&a&b\\b&c&a\end{vmatrix}$ का मान ______ है।
solution: For real $a,b,c$, $a+b\omega^{2}+c\omega=\overline{a+b\omega+c\omega^{2}}$, so the last two factors give $|a+b\omega+c\omega^{2}|^{2}=7$
solution_full: With $1+\omega+\omega^{2}=0$ and $\omega^{3}=1$, $(a+b\omega+c\omega^{2})(a+b\omega^{2}+c\omega)=a^{2}+b^{2}+c^{2}-ab-bc-ca$, and multiplying by $a+b+c$ gives $a^{3}+b^{3}+c^{3}-3abc$.
(Equivalently, adding all columns to the first shows $a+b+c$ is a factor, and adding $\omega$ and $\omega^{2}$ times the columns shows the other two factors.)
Such $a,b,c$ exist, for example $a=\dfrac{3}{2}$, $b=\dfrac{1}{2}$, $c=-\dfrac{3}{2}$, for which $a+b\omega+c\omega^{2}=2+i\sqrt{3}$; the value does not depend on the choice.
originality_note: New: the data fix only a+b+c and the modulus of a+b omega+c omega^2, yet the determinant is determined because the omega-factorisation pairs conjugate factors (way 4, invariant). Closest known: the circulant determinant equals a^3+b^3+c^3-3abc. Different because: a, b, c are not given and need not be found; the answer comes from the conjugate pair of omega-factors.
blueprint_concepts: Using omega to factorise and to simplify determinants

concept_use.Cube root of unity: 1+omega+omega^2 = 0 and conj(omega) = omega^2 make a+b omega^2+c omega the conjugate of a+b omega+c omega^2.
concept_use.Using omega to factorise and to simplify: The circulant determinant is factored as (a+b+c)(a+b omega+c omega^2)(a+b omega^2+c omega).

key_step: Factor the circulant determinant with omega and pair the conjugate factors into |a+b omega+c omega^2|^2.
justification: One known factorisation plus the conjugate-pair observation; a short routine chain. Level 2, near 2026-P1-Q13 (L3) in topic but lighter.
stem_review: Read as a student: every symbol, locus and parameter is introduced, the conditions are complete, there is one reading, the answer is unique and equals the Answer Plan, and the Hindi mirrors the English. Checked that real a, b, c with these data exist and that the determinant does not depend on the choice. Answer 3.5, positive decimal. No change.
